review:
The biggest grid in Wazdan's Grand Gold Coins run, with 25 separate reels. Cash Infinity symbols stay on to make the bonus easier to reach, and Sticky to Infinity keeps Mystery and Jackpot Mystery symbols locked until the next bonus ends.

The bonus is Hold the Jackpot with a 2,500x Grand. Cluster Collectors gather values, and with Collect to Infinity they stay active through the next bonus. Very high volatility and a 96.13% RTP, so expect long gaps between bonuses.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Free demo available on the Wazdan website
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
